title: RegoMender: A Multi-agent Framework for Automated Rego Policy Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.29456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy-as-Code (PaC) has emerged as a foundational paradigm in cloud-native systems. However, repairing Rego policies remains challenging due to their strict syntax, declarative semantics, and specific verification requirements. Existing automated program repair (APR) methods are mainly designed for mainstream languages and struggle to accommodate the unique policy logic and repair workflows of Rego. Thus, Rego policy repair remains a manual process driven by trial and error. To address this, we introduce RegoBench, the first automated Rego policy benchmark comprising 1,159 real-world defects, and propose RegoMender, a feedback-guided multi-agent framework. Collaborating via a shared blackboard and an atomic toolkit, RegoMender dynamically executes patching, rewriting, or rolling back, to resolve complex repair scenarios. translated_title: RegoMender：用于自动Rego策略修复的多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 策略即代码已成为云原生系统中的一种基础范式。然而，由于Rego策略严格的语法、声明式语义以及特定的验证要求，修复Rego策略仍然充满挑战。现有的自动程序修复（APR）方法主要针对主流编程语言设计，难以适应Rego独特的策略逻辑和修复工作流程。因此，Rego策略修复目前仍是一个依赖试错的手动过程。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RegoBench——首个自动化Rego策略基准，包含1,159个真实世界缺陷，并提出RegoMender，一个反馈引导的多智能体框架。RegoMender通过共享黑板机制和原子化工具包进行协作，动态执行打补丁、重写或回滚等操作，以应对复杂的修复场景。在RegoBench上的评估结果表明，RegoMender实现了82.9%的语法成功率和77.9%的基于测试的语义成功率。
tldr: 本文提出了首个Rego策略修复基准RegoBench（含1,159个真实缺陷）和反馈引导的多智能体框架RegoMender，通过共享黑板与原子工具包协作动态执行打补丁、重写或回滚，实现了82.9%的语法修复成功率和77.9%的语义修复成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RegoBench, the first automated Rego policy repair benchmark with 1,159 real-world defects, and RegoMender, a feedback-guided multi-agent framework that collaborates via a shared blackboard and atomic toolkit to dynamically patch, rewrite, or roll back, achieving 82.9% syntactic and 77.9% semantic repair success rates.
